abstract: Deploy and operate LobeHub (formerly LobeChat) v2 against self-hosted OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, LiteLLM, llama-swap). Covers the server-database Docker Compose install, proxy URLs and key handling, model list capability flags, Docker networking and SSRF allowlists, update and backup, and troubleshooting, with an env template.
